surface_name: Terraform provider v5 API rate limits
title: Cloudflare Terraform provider v5 plans and applies fail with 429 on accounts with many resources
symptoms: Error: failed to make http request ... 429 Too Many Requests
Large refreshes fail partway while small stacks work
The same config applied cleanly on provider v4
cause: Provider v5 does not throttle itself against Cloudflare API rate limits, so Terraform's default parallelism bursts past them. Maintainers acknowledged it and the issue is still open.
fix: Lower parallelism, split large stacks, and use refresh=false for targeted changes. Enterprise accounts can ask support for higher limits.
